paragraphs: Hubbell Incorporated (herein referred to as "Hubbell", the "Company", the "registrant", "we", "our" or "us", which references shall include its divisions and subsidiaries as the context may require) was founded as a proprietorship in 1888, and was incorporated in Connecticut in 1905. Recognized for our innovation, quality, and deep commitment to serving our customers for over 135 years, Hubbell is a world-class manufacturer of electrical and utility solutions, with more than 75 brands used around the world. We provide utility and electrical solutions that enable our customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently, and we empower and energize communities through innovative solutions supporting energy infrastructure In Front of the Meter, on The Edge, and Behind the Meter. In Front of the Meter is where utilities transmit and distribute energy to their customers. The Edge connects utilities with owners and operators and allows energy and data to be distributed back and forth. Behind the Meter is where owners and operators of building and other critical infrastructure consume energy.

Products are either sourced complete, manufactured or assembled by subsidiaries in the United States, Canada, Puerto Rico, Mexico, China, the United Kingdom ("UK"), Brazil, Australia, Spain, Ireland, and the Republic of the Philippines. The Company also participates in joint ventures in Hong Kong and the Republic of the Philippines, and maintains offices in Singapore, Italy, China, India, Mexico, South Korea, Chile, and countries in the Middle East.
The Company's reporting segments consist of the Utility Solutions segment and the Electrical Solutions segment.

The Company's annual report on Form 10-K, quarterly reports on Form 10-Q, current reports on Form 8-K, and all amendments to those reports are made available free of charge through the Investor Relations section of the Company's website at http://www.hubbell.com as soon as reasonably practicable after such material is electronically filed with, or furnished to, the SEC. The information contained on the Company's website or connected to our website is not incorporated by reference into this Annual Report on Form 10-K and should not be considered part of this report.

Hubbell Utility Solutions has leading positions In Front of the Meter and on The Edge. The Utility Solutions segment (63% of consolidated revenues in 2025, 64% in 2024 and 61% in 2023) consists of businesses that enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. The Utility Solutions segment provides critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible. This includes utility transmission & distribution (T&D) components such as arresters, insulators, connectors, anchors, bushings, enclosures, cutouts and switches. The Utility Solutions segment also offers solutions that serve The Edge of the utility infrastructure, including smart meters, communications systems, and protection and control devices. Hubbell Utility Solutions supports the electrical distribution, electrical substation, electrical transmission, gas distribution, telecommunications, utility meters & AMI, and grid protection and controls markets. While Hubbell believes its sales in this area are not materially dependent upon any customer or group of customers, a substantial variability in purchases by electrical utilities would affect this segment.

Products of the Utility Solutions segment are sold under various brands and/or trademarks into the electrical distribution, substation and transmission markets as well as, markets for grid protection and controls, utility meters and advanced metering infrastructure and telcom and gas distribution markets. The products are sold into these markets primarily through distributors, or directly to utilities. Brands and/or trademarks of products of the Utility Solutions segment include:
• Aclara® • Chance® • Anderson® • PenCell® • Fargo® • Hubbell® • Polycast® • Opti-loop Design®
• Quazite® • Quadri*sil® • Trinetics® • Reuel® • Electro Composites® • USCO™ • CDR™ • RFL Design®
• Hot Box® • PCORE® • Delmar™ • Turner Electric® • EMC™ • Longbow™ • Ohio Brass® • Meramec®
• Reliaguard® • Greenjacket® • Armorcast® • Beckwith Electric™ • Continental® • R.W. Lyall™ • Gas Breaker® • AEC™
• Ripley® • Electro Industries / Gauge Tech™ • Balestro™ • Systems Control™ • Nicor™ • DMC Power®

Hubbell Electrical Solutions is positioned Behind the Meter, consisting of businesses that are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Hubbell Electrical Solutions provides the critical components that allow operators of buildings, factories, and other industrial infrastructure to connect, protect, wire and manage power reliability and efficiency. The Electrical Solutions segment (37% of consolidated revenues in 2025, 36% in 2024 and 39% in 2023) comprises businesses that sell stock and custom products including standard and special application wiring device products, rough-in electrical products, and connector and grounding products, as well as other electrical equipment.

Products of the Electrical Solutions segment have applications in the non-residential, light industrial, heavy industrial, datacenter, electric transmission and distribution, and renewables markets. Electrical Solutions segment products are typically used in and around industrial, commercial and institutional facilities by electrical contractors, maintenance personnel, electricians, utilities, and telecommunications companies. In addition, certain of our businesses design and manufacture industrial controls and communication systems used in the non-residential and industrial markets. Many of these products are designed such that they can also be used in harsh and hazardous locations where a potential for fire and explosion exists due to the presence of flammable gasses and vapors. Harsh and hazardous products are primarily used in the oil and gas (onshore and offshore) and mining industries. We also offer a variety of wiring devices and electrical products that have residential and utility applications.

In December 2023, the Company entered into a definitive agreement to sell its residential lighting business for a cash purchase price of $131 million, subject to customary adjustments. The residential lighting business sells indoor and outdoor lighting solutions. The business generated $187.1 million in sales in 2023. The transaction closed in the first quarter of 2024 and the Company recorded a pre-tax loss on the sale of $5.3 million, which is recorded within Total other expense in the Company's Consolidated Statement of Income.

headings: Inflation and other unfavorable economic conditions may adversely affect our business results of operations and financial condition.

paragraphs: Our business, operating results, financial condition, and cash flows may be affected by a number of factors including, but not limited to those set forth below. Any one of these factors could cause our actual results to vary materially from recent results or future anticipated results. See also Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis — "Executive Overview of the Business" and "Results of Operations".

Our operating results can be sensitive to changes in general economic conditions, macro-economic effects of the U.S. government federal deficit, inflation, economic slowdowns, stagflation and recessions. Our sales are subject to market conditions that may cause customer demand for our products to be volatile and unpredictable. Product demand can be affected by fluctuations in domestic and international economic conditions, as well as currency fluctuations, commodity costs, and a variety of other factors.

We have in the past experienced, and may continue to experience, significant inflationary pressure across much of our business. Global supply chain issues and increased demand have in the past led to, and may continue to lead to, increased freight, labor and commodity costs. In addition, various factors, including the level of economic activity in China, the war between Ukraine and Russia and the conflict in the Middle East, have added, and may continue to add, to the volatility in energy costs. We have had to take various pricing actions to cover the increase in our costs associated with inflationary pressure and protect our margin profile. There can be no assurance that we will be able to maintain our margins in response to further changes in inflationary pressures.

In addition, macroeconomic effects such as increases in interest rates and other measures taken by central banks and other policy makers could have a negative effect on overall economic activity that could reduce our customers' demand for our products. Adverse changes in demand could impact our business, collection of accounts receivable and our expected cash flow generation from current and acquired businesses, which may adversely impact our financial condition and results of operations.

We compete on the basis of product performance, quality, service and/or price. Competitors' behavior related to these, among other areas, could potentially have significant impacts on our financial results. Our competitive strategy is to design and manufacture high quality products at the lowest possible cost. Our strategy is to also increase selling prices to offset rising costs of raw materials, components and logistics and supply chain matters when necessary. Competitive pricing pressures may not allow us to offset some or all of our increased costs through pricing actions. Alternatively, if raw material and component costs decline, the Company may not be able to maintain current pricing levels. Advancements in, and increased adoption of, artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, automation, and other advanced technologies may result in a long-term competitive disadvantage. Although, we continuously evaluate and utilize technologies that are appropriate for our business, there can be no assurance that such technologies will result in improved operational efficiencies, cost reductions, or other anticipated benefits. Competition could also affect future selling prices or demand for our products which could have an adverse impact on our results of operations, financial condition and cash flows.

Our international operations accounted for approximately 7% of our Net sales in 2025. We are exposed to the effects (both positive and negative) that fluctuating exchange rates have on translating the financial statements of our international operations, most of which are denominated in local currencies, into the U.S. dollar. Fluctuations in exchange rates may affect product demand and reported profits in our international operations. In addition, currency fluctuations may affect the prices we pay suppliers for materials used in our products, along with other local costs incurred in foreign countries for foreign entities with U.S. dollar functional currency. As a result, fluctuating exchange rates may adversely impact our results of operations and cash flows.

paragraphs: Hubbell is a global manufacturer of quality electrical products and utility solutions for a broad range of customer and end market applications. We provide utility and electrical solutions that enable our customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently, and we empower and energize communities through innovative solutions supporting energy infrastructure In Front of the Meter, on The Edge, and Behind the Meter. In Front of the Meter is where utilities transmit and distribute energy to their customers. The Edge connects utilities with owner/operators and allows energy and data to be distributed back and forth. Behind the Meter is where owners and operators of buildings, and other critical infrastructure consume energy. Products are either sourced complete, manufactured or assembled by subsidiaries in the United States, Canada, Puerto Rico, Mexico, China, the UK, Brazil, Australia, Spain, Ireland, and the Republic of the Philippines. The Company also participates in joint ventures in Hong Kong and the Republic of the Philippines, and maintains offices in Singapore, Italy, China, India, Mexico, South Korea, Chile, and countries in the Middle East. The Company employed approximately 18,000 individuals worldwide as of December 31, 2025.

The Company's reporting segments consist of the Utility Solutions segment and Electrical Solutions segment. The Company's long-term strategy is to: serve its customers with reliable and innovative electrical and related infrastructure solutions with desired brands and high-quality service, delivered through a competitive cost structure; to complement organic revenue growth with acquisitions that enhance its product offerings; and to allocate capital effectively to create shareholder value.

Our strategy to complement organic revenue growth with acquisitions is focused on acquiring assets that extend our capabilities, expand our product offerings, and present opportunities to compete in core, adjacent or complementary markets. In 2025 we invested $958 million in acquisitions that meet these objectives. Refer to Note 3 - Business Acquisitions and Dispositions in the Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements for further details on these acquisitions.

Our strategy to deliver products through a competitive cost structure has resulted in an ongoing program of restructuring and related activities. Our restructuring and related efforts include the consolidation of manufacturing and distribution facilities, and workforce actions, as well as streamlining and consolidating our back-office functions. The primary objectives of our restructuring and related activities are to optimize our manufacturing footprint, cost structure and effectiveness and the efficiency of our workforce.

Our goal is to have pricing and productivity programs that offset the impact of cost increases as well as pay for investments in key growth areas. Our cost structure may be subject to material and production cost increases from inflationary periods within the U.S. and global economies, and from trade and other tensions. In particular, we have been subject to recent periods of inflationary pressure in the global economy and also subject to cost increases as a result of tariff and other material cost increases from trade actions by the U.S. and other countries. Because material costs are approximately half of our cost of goods sold, volatility in this area can significantly impact profitability. Our pricing and productivity programs are intended to mitigate the risk to our operating margins related to these inflationary pressures and cost increases as a result of tariffs. Refer to our risk factor; Changes in U.S. and international trade policies may adversely impact our business and operating results; changes in U.S. trade policies could have a material adverse effect on us for additional information.

Our sales are subject to market conditions that may cause customer demand for our products to be volatile. Product demand can be affected by fluctuations in domestic and international economic conditions, as well as currency fluctuations, commodity costs, and a variety of other factors. Accordingly, there can be no assurance that we will be able to maintain our margins in response to further changes in inflationary pressures.

paragraphs: Hubbell Incorporated (以下簡稱為 "Hubbell", "本公司", "登記人", "我們", "本公司" 或 "我們", 這些稱謂應包括其分公司及子公司，視上下文而定) 於1888年作為獨資企業成立，並於1905年在康乃狄克州註冊為公司。本公司因創新、品質及對客戶的深層承諾而聞名，擁有超過135年的歷史，是全球知名的電氣與公用事業解決方案製造商，擁有超過75個品牌在全球使用。我們提供公用事業與電氣解決方案，使客戶能可靠且高效地運作關鍵基礎設施，並透過創新解決方案支持能源基礎設施，進而賦能與激勵社區。In Front of the Meter 是公用事業將能源傳輸與分配給客戶的區域。The Edge 連接公用事業與所有者與運營者，允許能源與數據雙向流通。Behind the Meter 是建築物及其他關鍵基礎設施的所有者與運營者消耗能源的區域。
產品或是由美國、加拿大、波多黎各、墨西哥、中國、英國 ("UK"), 巴西、澳洲、西班牙、愛爾蘭及菲律賓共和國的子公司完整取得、製造或組裝。本公司亦參與在香港及菲律賓共和國的合資企業，並在新加坡、義大利、中國、印度、墨西哥、韓國、智利及中東國家設有辦事處。
本公司應報告分部包括公用事業解決方案分部與電氣解決方案分部。
本公司年度報告表10-K、季報表10-Q、現況報告表8-K，以及所有對這些報告的修正案，皆可在本公司網站的投資者關係區免費取得，自這些資訊電子提交至，或提供給美國證券交易委員會 (SEC) 後，盡速提供。本公司網站或與本公司網站連結的資訊，並未納入本年度報告表10-K的參考，因此不得視為本報告的一部分。

Hubbell 公用事業解決方案分部在 In Front of the Meter 和 The Edge 領域擁有領導地位。公用事業解決方案分部 (2025年佔合併營業收入的63%，2024年為64%，2023年為61%) 包含使電網能進行能源傳輸、通訊與控制的業務。公用事業解決方案分部提供關鍵零組件，使電網能可靠地傳輸與分配能源，以及通訊與控制技術，使電網更智慧且更具彈性。這包括電力傳輸與分配 (T&D) 零組件，如避雷器、絕緣子、連接器、錨點、套管、外殼、切斷裝置與開關。公用事業解決方案分部亦提供服務 The Edge 的解決方案，包括智慧電表、通訊系統及保護與控制裝置。Hubbell 公用事業解決方案分部支持電氣配電、電氣變電站、電氣輸電、天然氣配電、電信、公用電表與AMI、以及電網保護與控制市場。雖然本公司認為此領域的銷售並非嚴重依賴任何客戶或客戶羣，但電力公用事業的購買變動將影響此分部。
公用事業解決方案分部的產品以各種品牌與/或商標銷售至電氣配電、變電站與輸電市場，以及電網保護與控制、公用電表與先進電表基礎設施及電信與天然氣配電市場。這些產品主要透過經銷商或直接銷售給公用事業。公用事業解決方案分部產品的品牌與/或商標包括：
• Aclara® • Chance® • Anderson® • PenCell® • Fargo® • Hubbell® • Polycast® • Opti-loop Design®
• Quazite® • Quadri*sil® • Trinetics® • Reuel® • Electro Composites® • USCO™ • CDR™ • RFL Design®
• Hot Box® • PCORE® • Delmar™ • Turner Electric® • EMC™ • Longbow™ • Ohio Brass® • Meramec®
• Reliaguard® • Greenjacket® • Armorcast® • Beckwith Electric™ • Continental® • R.W. Lyall™ • Gas Breaker® • AEC™
• Ripley® • Electro Industries / Gauge Tech™ • Balestro™ • Systems Control™ • Nicor™ • DMC Power®

Hubbell Electrical Solutions 位於 Behind the Meter，包含對管理各產業與應用領域電力至關重要的業務。Hubbell Electrical Solutions 提供讓大樓、工廠及其他工業基礎設施操作者能連接、保護、布線及管理電力可靠度與效率的關鍵零組件。電氣解決方案分部（2025 年為合併營業收入的 37%，2024 年為 36%，2023 年為 39%）包含銷售現成與客製化產品的業務，包括標準與特殊應用的配線設備產品、粗裝電氣產品、連接器與接地產品，以及其它電氣設備。

電氣解決方案分部的產品應用於非住宅、輕工業、重工業、資料中心、電力傳輸與配電，以及可再生能源市場。電氣解決方案分部的產品通常由電氣承包商、維護人員、電工、電力公司及電信業者用於工業、商業與機構設施附近。此外，部分業務設計與製造用於非住宅與工業市場的工業控制與通訊系統。許多這些產品設計為也可用於危險與惡劣環境，因這些環境可能因易燃氣體與蒸氣的存在而有火災與爆炸的風險。危險與惡劣環境用產品主要用於石油與天然氣（陸上與海上）及礦業。我們也提供多種配線設備與電氣產品，具有住宅與電力公司應用。
2023年12月，本公司與買方簽訂最終協議，以現金買斷其住宅照明業務，買價為131 百萬美元，並依慣例進行調整。該住宅照明業務銷售室內及室外照明解決方案。該業務在2023年產生銷售額為187.1 百萬美元。交易於2024年第一季完成，本公司於出售時認列預稅損失5.3 百萬美元，此損失計入本公司合併損益表之總其他費用項目。

paragraphs: Hubbell 是一家全球性製造商，提供高品質電氣產品與電力解決方案，應用於廣泛的客戶與終端市場。我們提供電力與電氣解決方案，使客戶能可靠且高效地運作關鍵基礎設施，並透過創新解決方案支持能源基礎設施，進而賦能與激勵社區。In Front of the Meter 是電力公司將能源傳輸與分配給客戶的區域。The Edge 連接電力公司與擁有者/營運者，允許能源與數據雙向流通。Behind the Meter 是建築物擁有者與營運者，以及其他關鍵基礎設施消耗能源的區域。產品或是由美國、加拿大、波多黎各、墨西哥、中國、英國、巴西、澳洲、西班牙、愛爾蘭與菲律賓共和國的子公司完整組裝、製造或組裝。本公司亦參與在香港與菲律賓共和國的合資企業，並在新加坡、義大利、中國、印度、墨西哥、南韓、智利與中東國家設有辦事處。本公司截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，全球約僱用 18,000 名員工。
本公司的應報告分部包括電力解決方案分部與電氣解決方案分部。本公司的長期策略為：以具競爭力的成本結構，提供客戶可靠且創新電氣與相關基礎設施解決方案，並透過優質服務與受歡迎的品牌；以收購活動補強有機營收成長；並有效配置資本以創造股東價值。
我們以收購活動補強有機營收成長的策略，聚焦於取得能拓展我們能力、擴充產品組合，並提供在核心、相關或補充市場競爭機會的資產。2025 年，我們投資 9.58 億美元用於符合這些目標的收購。有關這些收購的更多細節，請參閱財務報表附註中的第 3 註 - 企業收購與處分。
我們以具競爭力的成本結構交付產品的策略，已導致持續進行重整與相關活動。我們的重整與相關努力包括製造與分銷設施的整併、人力資源行動，以及簡化與整併後勤作業功能。我們重整與相關活動的主要目標為優化製造據點、成本結構與效益，以及人力資源的效率。

我們的目標是透過定價與生產力方案，抵銷成本增加的影響，並支應關鍵成長領域的投資。我們的成本結構可能因美國與全球經濟的通貨膨脹時期，以及貿易與其他緊張關係而產生重大且生產成本的增加。特別是，我們近期面臨全球經濟的通貨膨脹壓力，並因美國及其他國家的貿易行動而產生成本增加。因為原材料成本約佔我們銷售成本的一半，此領域的波動可能顯著影響利潤。我們的定價與生產力方案旨在緩解這些通貨膨脹壓力與因關稅導致的成本增加對營運毛利的風險。請參閱我們的風險因素；美國與國際貿易政策的變動可能對我們的業務與營運結果產生不利影響；美國貿易政策的變動可能對我們產生重大不利影響，以取得更多資訊。
我們的銷售受市場條件影響，可能導致客戶對我們產品的需求波動。產品需求可能受國內與國際經濟條件的波動、貨幣兌換率變動、商品成本以及多種其他因素影響。因此，無法保證我們能因應進一步的通貨膨脹壓力變動而維持我們的毛利率。

headings: 通貨膨脹及其他不利的經濟條件可能不利於我們的營業成果與財務狀況。

貨幣交換率的波動可能不利於我們的財務狀況、營業成果與現金流。
我們有效開發並推出新產品的能力可能不利於我們的競爭能力。
我們可能需要對我們的商譽及其他無形資產認列減損費用。
本公司從事收購及戰略投資，並可能遇到取得適當收購目標之困難，以及整合這些業務之困難。
本公司可能無法成功實施各項計畫，包括持續進行之重整活動，以提高生產力及簡化作業流程，以控制或降低營運成本。
本公司取得資本市場之能力，或未能維持信用評等，可能對本公司業務造成不利影響。
客戶信用品質惡化、失去重要客戶、業務大幅減少，或因客戶而產生之價格壓力，可能對本公司營運成果及財務狀況造成重大不利影響。

若本公司之確定福利計畫之基礎投資未如預期表現，本公司可能需對這些計畫做出額外之提撥。

考量稅法的解釋性與持續演變性，實際稅款支付可能與目前記載的有所不同。
美國與國際貿易政策的變動可能對我們的業務與營運結果產生不利影響；美國貿易政策的變動可能對我們造成重大不利影響。

全球經濟不確定性可能對本公司造成不利影響。
paragraphs: 本公司之業務、營運成果、財務狀況及現金流可能受多種因素影響，包括但不限於下列所列因素。上述任一因素均可能導致本公司實際成果與近期成果或預期未來成果有重大差異。請參閱第 7 項 管理層討論與分析 — 「業務總覽」及「營運成果」。
本公司營運成果可能受總體經濟條件變動、美國政府聯邦財政赤字之總體經濟影響、通貨膨脹、經濟減速、停滯通脹及經濟衰退等因素影響。本公司銷售額受市場條件影響，可能導致客戶對本公司產品之需求波動且難以預測。產品需求可能受國內外經濟條件變動、貨幣兌換率變動、商品成本及其他多種因素影響。

本公司過去曾經驗過，且可能持續經驗，許多業務領域之通貨膨脹壓力。全球供應鏈問題及需求增加，過去已導致，且可能持續導致，運輸、人力及商品成本增加。此外，多種因素，包括中國經濟活動程度、烏克蘭與俄羅斯之間戰爭及中東地區衝突，已增加，且可能持續增加，能源成本之波動。本公司已採取多種價格調整措施，以彌補因通貨膨脹壓力所致成本增加，並保護毛利率。無法保證本公司將能因應進一步通貨膨脹壓力變動而維持現有毛利率。
此外，總體經濟影響，例如利率上升及其他中央銀行及其他政策制定者所採取之措施，可能對整體經濟活動產生負面影響，進而降低客戶對本公司產品之需求。需求變動可能影響本公司業務、應收帳款之回收及來自現有及收購業務之預期現金流產生，可能對本公司財務狀況及營運成果產生負面影響。

本公司以產品性能、品質、服務及/或價格作為競爭基礎。競爭對手在這些領域及其他領域之行為，可能對本公司財務成果產生重大影響。本公司競爭策略為設計與製造高品質產品，並以最低可能成本進行。本公司策略亦為在必要時提高銷售價格，以彌補原材料、零組件及物流與供應鏈相關成本之上升。競爭性價格壓力可能無法讓本公司透過價格調整措施彌補部分或全部成本增加。反之，若原材料及零組件成本下降，本公司可能無法維持現有銷售價格。人工智慧（AI）、機器學習、自動化及其他先進科技之進步與廣泛採用，可能導致長期競爭劣勢。雖然本公司持續評估並運用適當於本公司業務之科技，但無法保證這些科技將帶來運營效率提升、成本降低或其他預期效益。競爭亦可能影響未來產品之銷售價格或需求，可能對本公司營運成果、財務狀況及現金流產生負面影響。
本公司國際業務在 2025 年佔淨銷售額約 7%。本公司面臨匯率波動對國際業務財務報表之影響（包括正面與負面影響），其中大多數國際業務以當地貨幣計價，並需轉換為美元。匯率波動可能影響國際業務之產品需求及報表利潤。此外，匯率波動可能影響本公司向供應商支付材料費用，以及在海外國家為具有美元功能貨幣之外資企業所產生之其他當地成本。因此，匯率波動可能對本公司營運成果及現金流產生負面影響。
